notes.title: Demo Build Update Notes #3
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/912eeb048a1a9baddccb1b13586aef339a11c4fb.png"]



Greetings, Warriors of Pyron,

Here are the update details for the VER.0.5.45 demo build.


Bug Fixes
Fixed the timing issue of the Creature Wave gate closing in Earth Port


Updates
Changed the map icon that marks the player’s death location

Added a UI notification when acquiring a new Core Stone

Added a tutorial for moving between Stat Core Stones  Skill Core Stones when acquiring a new Core Stone

Added control key explanations for the Breakfall Core Stone



We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback.

Please feel free to share your thoughts on Discord or the Steam forums!



Thank you,

Studio Doodal

notes.title: Demo Build Update Notes #2
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/8e117bd3fa9730d2b46ef7bebadf62cf292e9aee.png"]



Greetings, Warriors of Pyron,

Here are the bug fixes included in the VER.0.5.39 demo build.


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the UI guide for moving between Stat Corestones  Skill Corestones on console was not displayed

Fixed an issue where fast travel to the Library from other regions was unavailable

Renamed certain Corestones


Updates
Fidiel

Adjusted HP/Defense ratio

Reduced overall HP

Adjusted attack power of certain patterns

Player

Reduced effectiveness of Strength Corestone

For player balancing, the attack power growth formula has been adjusted.

Corrected hit range of the 4th combo attack

Increased the hit range of the 4th attack to ensure it always lands properly.



We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback.

Please feel free to share your thoughts on Discord or the Steam forums!



Thank you,

Studio Doodal

notes.title: Demo Build Update Notes #1
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/ddd6419ea57b480162c6a4b9d925ab327d3ddec6.png"]

Hello Pyron warriors, Here are the bug fixes and updates for the VER.0.5.3.0 demo build.



Bug Fixes
Added the missing incapacitate motion of [spoiler]Guardian of Teradin [/spoiler]

Fixed an issue where the screen continued to display after clearing [spoiler]Guardian of Teradin[/spoiler] and moving to the next area

Fixed an issue where the blue diamond indicator for newly acquired items did not disappear in the inventory

Fixed an issue with [spoiler]Teradin Gatekeeper[/spoiler]: after lever interaction was forcibly canceled due to being hit, sometimes the lever could not be opened

Fixed an issue where npc [spoiler]Lunya[/spoiler] could be invited to the library

Fixed an issue where input prompts remained displayed in some tutorials



Updates
Lowered the difficulty of the early part of the Silent Ruins region

Reduced grab damage of the boss [spoiler]Fidiel[/spoiler]

Reduced creature homing performance: The original performance was too strong and caused discomfort for many players, so it has been toned down.

Adjusted some creature motions so that attack motions are more visible

Changed shockwave pattern of mid-boss [spoiler]Moomoo[/spoiler]

Applied some missing scripts

Corrected some mistranslations




We will continue to improve the game through player feedback.
Please feel free to share your thoughts anytime via Discord or Steam discussions!




Thank you.

From Studio Doodal

notes.title: Solateria Dev Log #01
notes.content:
Hello Pyron Warriors,

Since we began developing Solateria in January last year, this is our first time greeting you through a development log.
From now on, we plan to share monthly updates so that you can follow the game’s progress and improvements with us.

After showcasing our early build at various exhibitions, we’ve made major improvements:
We added clear rewards for parrying and restructured the gameplay to better support parry-focused combat.
We also introduced the Heat System to further reflect the identity of the flame warrior.

Additionally, we refined the creature designs, rebalanced background tones, and created new cutscenes.
Your feedback—both online and offline—made these changes possible, and we thank you for it.

This current build is vastly different from the one shown before.
We hope to share it with you soon. Now, let’s begin the April development log.


[Solateria – Development Log #01]

1. New Cutscenes
We focused on a variety of cinematic scenes this month—
From narrative moments with NPCs in beautiful landscapes, to dramatic boss deaths and wave finales.
We’ll first reveal a new cutscene from the Ashen Library, a safe haven for warriors who survived the Shadow Plague.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/9647a363f73cef8038132e12c9cd811bb5d2a1d7.gif

2. Parts System
We’ve added a parts system to let you tailor your build:
Attack, Defense, Heat, and Wormhorn parts each offer unique enhancements, such as bonus damage under low health or persistent effects.
Equip one part of each type to customize your combat experience and explore more playstyles.

3. Heat System
To highlight the Pyron identity, we added the Heat System, which allows warriors to channel their inner fire.
Unlockable in five tiers, this system enables special abilities in combat depending on your current heat level—
And at full charge, you’ll gain access to a powerful finisher.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/5fd3e85f3f94c137476ead0cffd7030f28f5a458.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/4972c21e62c8f1ae338be5c1e9254a1478314074.gif

That’s it for April’s development log.
Thank you always for playing Solateria, and we’ll see you again in next month’s update.
- Studio Doodal
